title: PCLA-Bridge: A Framework for Cross-Domain Deployment of CARLA Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.28696v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Most high-performing end-to-end autonomous driving agents (ADAs) are developed for the CARLA Leaderboard, tightly coupling them to CARLA's APIs, sensor layouts, coordinate systems, and internal clock. Reusing these models on real datasets, alternative simulators, or physical platforms necessitates substantial manual re-engineering. We present PCLA-Bridge, a deployable tool that runs unmodified CARLA Leaderboard agents from any sensor source to any control destination without an active CARLA server. With PCLA-Bridge handling dependency isolation, tensor marshalling, routing, and synthetic timing, integrators only need to provide a minimal interface. We validate the tool across two operational paradigms: offline replay on in-domain CARLA recordings and real-world nuScenes logs, and live closed-loop control across three diverse simulation engines: MetaDrive, AWSIM, and AlpaSim. translated_title: PCLA-Bridge：一个用于CARLA智能体跨域部署的框架
translated_abstract: 大多数高性能的端到端自动驾驶智能体（ADAs）都是为CARLA排行榜开发的，这导致它们与CARLA的API、传感器布局、坐标系和内部时钟紧密耦合。要在真实数据集、其他模拟器或物理平台上复用这些模型，需要进行大量的手动重新工程。我们提出了PCLA-Bridge，这是一个可部署的工具，能够在没有活跃CARLA服务器的情况下，运行未经修改的CARLA排行榜智能体，实现从任意传感器源到任意控制目标的转换。借助PCLA-Bridge处理依赖隔离、张量封送、路由和合成时序，集成者只需提供一个最小接口。我们在两种运行范式下对该工具进行了验证：一是在域内CARLA录制数据和真实世界nuScenes日志上进行离线回放，二是在三个不同的模拟引擎（MetaDrive、AWSIM和AlpaSim）上进行实时闭环控制。我们分析了每种平台所需的轻量级集成要求。
tldr: PCLA-Bridge是一个无需修改代码即可将CARLA排行榜自动驾驶智能体跨域部署到其他模拟引擎、真实数据集和物理平台的工具，它通过处理依赖隔离、张量封送、路由和合成时序，使集成者只需提供最小接口即可完成复用。
en_tdlr: PCLA-Bridge is a deployable framework that enables unmodified CARLA Leaderboard autonomous driving agents to run across diverse simulators, real-world datasets, and physical platforms—handling dependency isolation, tensor marshalling, routing, and synthetic timing—so that integrators only need to provide a minimal interface.
